name: KinThread
positioning: The coordination hub for small home-care agencies—schedules, caregiver notes, and family updates kept orderly in one earnest place.

hero.h1: Run your care agency without the guesswork
hero.sub: KinThread keeps caregivers, families, and shift schedules on the same page—so nothing about a client's care slips through the cracks.

features.title: Shift schedules that hold up
features.description: Fill open visits, track call-offs, and see coverage gaps before a client is left waiting at the door.

features.title: Caregiver notes, not sticky pads
features.description: Every visit note, med reminder, and mood observation lives on the client's timeline—readable by the next caregiver on shift.

features.title: Family updates on autopilot
features.description: Send adult children a plain-language summary after each visit, so the phone stops ringing with 'how's Mom doing?'

features.title: Every visit accounted for
features.description: Clock-in and clock-out with location stamps give you clean records for payroll, billing, and the state audit.

features.title: Care plans that stay current
features.description: Update a care plan once and every assigned caregiver sees the change on their next visit—no reprinting binders.

features.title: See your whole roster
features.description: One dashboard shows who's on shift, who's available, and which clients still need coverage today.

testimonials.quote: We went from a whiteboard and three group texts to one screen. My schedulers stopped chasing caregivers and started actually managing care.
testimonials.name: Denise Ferraro

testimonials.quote: The family update feature alone paid for KinThread. Adult children finally trust us because they hear from us after every single visit.
testimonials.name: Marcus Oyelaran

testimonials.quote: During our state audit, I pulled clean visit logs in ten minutes. Before KinThread that was a two-day scramble through paper timesheets.
testimonials.name: Carol Whitfield

pricing.blurb: For owner-operators running a small, hands-on roster.
For growing agencies coordinating families and staff daily.
For multi-location groups with centralized oversight.

homepage.footerBlurb: KinThread is coordination software for the people who show up—helping small home-care agencies keep caregivers, families, and clients connected.
